# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue. Report privately through GitHub Security Advisories
("Report a vulnerability" on the Security tab of this repository).
We aim to acknowledge reports within 3 business days.

## Supported versions

Only the latest release on `main` is supported. This is a community-supported Snowflake Labs
sample and is provided as-is, with no SLA.

## Scope notes

Do not include real credentials, tokens, or tenant data in reports.
